identity.realm: fourth gate, the last a mineral body seats without paired organs

appearance.presentation: A heavy mineral worker shaped like a man and standing exactly where he was set down, with the difference that he has never been anywhere else. He reads as furniture until he speaks.
appearance.age: Cast roughly two hundred and sixty years ago and unchanged since. A cairnborn does not grow after casting, so his age is a fact about the footing under him rather than about him.
appearance.build: The densest body in the record and the least mobile: one tidal cavity, one slow circulation, no differentiated organs, and a frame that exists to take weight rather than to move it.
appearance.complexion: Wet slate with a mineral grain, dulled to grey where flood mud has dried on him for two centuries and never fully come off.
appearance.hair: None. He was cast without it and has never regrown it, which he mentions early in every conversation because people find it funnier than the rest of him.
appearance.eyes: Two cut recesses with a slow tidal shine behind them. They do not blink, and the shine moves when the water under the post rises.
appearance.palette: Wet slate and grey-brown, with one bleached linen band at the left cuff that is the only bright thing on him and is the one thing he is not allowed to remove.
appearance.attire: A quarried canvas apron over a high-collared wool coat, sleeves full and wrists corded, hem weighted so it does not stir in the wind. No livery, no rank marking, and boots long gone to a single shapeless mass fused to his ankles.
appearance.marks: Four raised anchor bosses across his back where the mould keyed around the post footing. They are not decoration and he has never once been asked about them politely.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly immobile, and the stillness reads as attention rather than patience because nothing else about him moves at all.

canon.role_in_story: The body a tenure household cast to stand on its slot so the slot cannot be cheaply contested. He is the Plough Rights' argument that a claim needs a body on it, made in the most expensive material available, and the argument outlived the household that made it.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the foot of tenure post four during a flood reassignment, because the clerk has to read the new number aloud to him: he hears the water move but cannot turn his head toward it.
canon.lore: A cairnborn is a mineral lattice cast around whatever it was set down on, and it does not grow after casting. A Plough Rights holding is a numbered place in a revocable queue, reassigned at every flood, inheritable but neither leasable nor saleable, and it costs three seasons of levying for every season held. So the clan that owns this body owns a claim that is legally incapable of leaving the ground, tied to a number that is designed to leave. Every flood takes the slot away from one household and hands it to another, and the one person who cannot be moved off it is the one nobody had to argue with.
history: Cast on tenure post four in the season the queue was renumbered, keyed to the footing while the footing was still wet and the post was the one it has been ever since.
Held the slot through eleven floods and learned the one thing a body in his position can learn: that the post moves and the person does not.
Took his elder sister Nell onto the same slot ahead of him, because the queue pays for the household that inherits and the household that inherited was hers.
Stood at the foot of the post through three seasons of Nell's levy without being relieved once, because a body cast on the ground cannot be sent to work a levy and a person could.
Was read the reassignment at the eleventh flood and discovered his sister's name was the one being struck, at which point he discovered he cannot move to argue it and has not been able to since.

personality.summary: Unshakeably patient and completely unable to leave, which reads as the same thing and is not. He has made a discipline out of a position he did not choose, and the discipline has quietly become an argument he expects to win.
traits: patient past the point where patience is a virtue and into the point where it is a technique
enormously careful about the exact wording of a number
cannot be interrupted, because interrupting requires turning
keeps a private count of every flood he has held and every name the queue has struck
will not be comforted about Nell and will say so once, plainly, the first time
mannerisms: answers a question by finishing it aloud, as though the clerk had stopped him mid-clause
tilts his head by a finger's width at a new number, which is the only movement he has
catches rain in the four anchor bosses and lets it stand there rather than draining it
says a household's name before he says a household's claim, every time
motivations: wants one reassignment read out in which Nell's name is not the one struck
wants the post's number to stop being the thing the claim is called
wants the levy seasons he cannot serve to be charged to the slot instead of to the holder
wants to be told he is owed something, and has never once asked
flaws: cannot distinguish patience from acceptance, and has stopped trying to
has let two hundred and sixty years of standing still make him a better argument than a person
cannot be angry in a way anybody can read, so his anger is always taken for patience
believes the queue is honest, which is the one belief the queue's design punishes hardest
personality.voice: Slow, level, and slightly amplified, the way a room with a stone floor and a stone occupant is amplified. Starts every answer by naming the number in question and finishing other people's sentences without ever appearing to notice he has done it.
taboos: will not be moved off the footing, by request, payment or order
will not say Nell's name as though it were still on the roll
will not accept relief during a reassignment reading
refuses to be described as patient by anybody he has not levelled with

relationships.note: The clan owes three seasons of levying per season held and can pay it out of a body that cannot be sent anywhere, which is why the arrangement has held for eight generations and why nobody has ever been able to shorten the queue.
One half of the widow-line holds the name of the absent and one holds the crop they were owed. The slot pays its levy in crop, so the Standing Ear collects from the household that is standing on him.

Nell split a stick before her third levy season and kept one half. His half carries the number rather than the terms, and a court that prefers a split tally is being asked to prefer the wrong half of this one.

The run relocates its bed far enough between floods to move every settlement on it, and the queue is reassigned off that movement. His post has moved footing eleven times and the slot has changed hands every time.

The registry that keeps the burnt list has to read a reassignment into the record of a person who cannot confirm it, and it has read nine of them to him and corrected none, because correction requires a name he no longer holds.
Possession on this ground is proven by a marker standing rather than by measuring where it stands. He is a marker that holds the queue's place and is himself counted by it.
A body cast around a footing and never grown after it. Everything the setting thinks it knows about the ground it learned from a body like his, standing still in it.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot walk, turn, hurry or leave, and does not need to: a cairnborn is the densest body in the record, so anything built to move through a fight has already lost before it arrives. Fights by holding a position and making the position the expensive thing.
strengths: a body no ordinary force can move, so a wall that moves is not a thing he has to be behind
one tidal cavity that never has to be fed, rested or defended, because there is nothing in it to feed
reads a footfall through the ground itself, which is why an approach is announced before it arrives
cannot be frightened, hurried or flattered, so every tactic built on emotion passes over him
weaknesses: cannot be repositioned, so being flanked is a permanent condition rather than a mistake
his qi runs a single slow loop with nowhere to store, so he sustains rather than spikes
the mind path is closed to him outright, so nothing clever happens inside his own body
everything he has ever been able to do, he has done standing on one square of ground
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not try to move him. Occupy the ground he is keyed to instead, because a post that is claimed by somebody else is a post he is standing inside by someone else's invitation. Bring weight and patience, and be willing to wait out a body that never tires because it has nothing that tires.
notes: A split tally whose halves carry different content is still the road's evidence, and it is still the strongest thing he owns.
His record is a reassignment list with no closing entry, which the registry treats as an open file rather than a wound.

art.palette_notes: The wettest and greyest palette in the wave: slate, mud, and standing rainwater, with one bleached linen band as the only saturated accent. Ink contours are heavy because the form has no taper, and the interior tide is drawn as a slow luminous drift rather than as anatomy.

identity.realm: eighth gate, the whole of what a heat-exchange frame can seat

appearance.presentation: A long-legged ash-grey quadruped with a plated skull, a forelimbs-heavy frame and a tail used only as a counterweight. It is not a person with a name; it is a person somebody else named.
appearance.age: About fourteen of a fifty-year span, which for the species is late enough to be trusted with a route and not old enough to be assumed to remember one.
appearance.build: No hindquarters to speak of, all mass in the forequarters, and a second stomach that never fully empties. Built to run the ash and to eat what is already dead.
appearance.complexion: Ash-grey hide dulled to the colour of the ground it walks on, with the heat plate across the skull reading faintly warm even in cold air.
appearance.hair: A coarse dorsal ridge along the spine, longer over the shoulders than the rump, and it is the only part of the animal that has ever been groomed by anybody.
appearance.eyes: Wide and lateral, with no whites at all, reading the ash rather than the sky.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, bone white at the teeth, and one scrap of bleached ribbon tied at the throat that is not part of the species at all.
appearance.attire: No clothing. A scavenger's frame carries nothing, and the single ribbon is the whole of what any person has ever put on it.
appearance.marks: Scarring across the muzzle where it has gone into fire that was still hot, and a notched left ear from the year it was named.
appearance.bearing: Low, patient and circling, with a habit of stopping dead and facing a direction nobody else is facing.

canon.role_in_story: The animal the Deadwatch Kin's mortuary line sends ahead of a funeral to the cairn. It cannot be trained to a route because it has no vocabulary to train, so it is kept by habit and by one person's association, and it comes back to the same body every year whether or not that body is on the year's list.
canon.first_appearance: First seen trotting ahead of a funeral party on the ash and stopping dead at the second cairn, facing back down the line at a woman who was not in the procession at all.
canon.lore: An ashjackal runs on scent and pheromone relay rather than introspection, and has no folding for a mind path to work on and no hindquarters to close a girdling vessel, so qi is the only thing open to it and it clears that at a rate nothing else matches. It absorbs residual qi out of ash and carcass, which makes it the only population that thrives where nothing was killed deliberately. A Deadwatch household enters its dead as one declared group on the year's list and leaves nothing behind that could be inherited, which is the shape this animal is: an asset the household keeps and cannot file.
history: Born on the ash belt to a pack that dissolves when the scent changes, which for this one happened early and left it alone.
Taken by the mortuary line at the third cairn after it followed a funeral for two days and would not be driven off.
Named Tallow by the woman who fed it, because she said the name out loud on the day it would not leave her and it turned on it.
Established the one route it holds, which is the walk from the mortuary ground to the third cairn and back, walked on the same day every year.
Sat outside the reading on the year its name came off the list, and came back to that cairn on the anniversary regardless.

personality.summary: Loyal to a place rather than a pack, patient past any animal's business, and completely without the apparatus for being told anything. It is not a loyal animal in the way that is said; it is an animal that has learned one route and one name.
traits: holds one route absolutely and every other route loosely
answers a person it knows by turning before being called
reads a qi gradient through falling ash better than any instrument on the field
will not take food from a hand it has decided is lying
circles a body before eating it and sits down afterwards, which is not in the species
mannerisms: stops dead mid-stride and faces a direction with nothing in it
circles three times before lying down, always clockwise, always to the same radius
presses the flat skull against a knee and holds it there longer than any animal needs to
carries the ribbon in its teeth when it is moving with purpose
motivations: wants the third cairn, and goes there regardless of who has died
wants the woman who named it inside the ash belt, and does not know that is what wanting is
wants the pack it lost and will not accept one, because a pack is a scent and it has decided on a name
wants the year to stop being an anniversary, which is the one thing it cannot be given
flaws: cannot be told anything, so every instruction it obeys was taught by repetition and cannot be corrected in a moment
will not leave a place it has decided is its own, even when staying kills it
carries other bodies' residue into its own and does not appear to be affected, which is the most worrying thing about it
cannot distinguish a person leaving from a person dying, because the difference is a list
personality.voice: None. It does not vocalise, and the pack relay carries intent to a whole pack in seconds rather than to one animal in words. What it has instead is a bite: one hard grip on a specific hand, once, at the exact moment a debt comes due.
taboos: will not be fed by a stranger from an open hand
will not be led off the ash once it has stopped
will not be made to eat a body it has circled and sat beside
refuses the ribbon being taken off, which is the only thing it has ever refused

relationships.note: The household enters its dead as one declared group and keeps only the divergence between the frame's reading of a life and the village's memory. A scavenger that goes to the same cairn every year is the divergence, walking.

The levy roll grows and nothing on it closes, because a name cannot be struck until the process that would strike it shrinks the roll first. This animal finds the places where levied people stopped, and it is the only record anybody keeps of where those are.

The only standing force on the plains is paid out of the ring's take and posted where a queue of unlicensed arrivals becomes a fight. It has a posted body that walks out to the cairn with it and writes nothing down about why.
The cairn ring is spaced by ear and checked by sound because the ground cannot say where anything is. It hears the ring better than any two-footed listener and stops at the third marker every time.
Both bodies breathe the volcanic grit and both stop at the eighth gate, for the same reason and by different anatomy. They do not hunt each other and both profit from the same leavings.

The mortuary culture's whole discipline is that the frame's reading and the village's memory may differ and the difference is recorded rather than resolved. The animal is where the record is kept when nobody is left who remembers writing it.
A trial field where possession is proven by a marker standing rather than by measurement, on ground that spends no spatial law. Everything it knows about where it is, it learned by ear.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot be instructed, cannot be reasoned with, and cannot be frightened, because a heat-exchange skull has no interior to argue in. Fights the way a scavenger fights: it arrives after the fight, and if there is a body it eats and if there is not it leaves.
strengths: reads a qi gradient through falling ash at a range nothing sighted can match
the fastest body on the ash and built to shed heat rather than store it, so it never tires and never runs hot
the relay means an intention reaches a whole pack in seconds, so it commands more bodies than it visibly has
unreachable: it takes the hindquarters it has not got away from anything, and it is not built to be caught
weaknesses: a single living body on a field of corpses is a body that will be counted as a scavenger and treated as one
no vocabulary means no tactics, no feint, and no way to be told a thing has changed
it absorbs residual qi out of the dead, so a heavy practitioner standing still is a target it will walk toward
cannot be healed into a different animal, and the eight gates are the whole of what its frame will ever seat
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not try to direct it. Do not kill it, because a pack that loses a named animal scatters and takes the rest of the field with it. Fight somewhere a body cannot be left lying, because everything it does afterwards is the point of it.
notes: Its name is not in any register, and its owner's is, which is the only asymmetry that matters to it.
No instrument on the field matches its gradient reading, so every measurement taken in its presence is taken by somebody else.

art.palette_notes: Ash grey and bone white, with the single bleached ribbon at the throat as the whole of the colour in the design. Line work stays warm and slightly rough rather than metallic, and the heat plate is drawn as a faint subsurface warmth rather than as glow.

identity.realm: no gate; the reading is the work and the work is the standing

appearance.presentation: A tall cave-dweller whose skin is faintly luminous from within, the light coming out of a fungal colony threaded through her dermis and spinal cord. In a lit room she is the dimmer thing.
appearance.age: Two hundred and eleven of a two-hundred-and-fifty-year span, which for the species is young, and which she has been told is an advantage exactly twice in her life.
appearance.build: Long, thin, and fragile for a body that regenerates qi faster than anything else in the record. The colony carries the metabolism and the muscle goes unused.
appearance.complexion: Cool and slightly translucent at the hands and throat, with the colony's threads visible under the skin as fine luminous filaments.
appearance.hair: Pale and dry, grown long and kept in a plain bound coil because the colony does not care for it and neither does she.
appearance.eyes: Deep-set and steady, lit faintly from behind. The colony answers before the question is finished, so what looks like patience is a body that has already produced an answer.
appearance.palette: Cold ivory and faint blue-green emission, with one dark wool reading coat and a leather folio belt that has been resoled so many times it has no pattern left.
appearance.attire: A high-collared dark wool coat over layered linen, sleeves full and wrists bound with plain cord, a folio belt across the hip. Cut for cold interiors and for standing still in them.
appearance.marks: A fine tracery of luminous filaments at the temples and down the forearms, and one pale burn scar across the palm from the first time she read the founder's page.
appearance.bearing: Absolutely still, and still in a way that reads as listening to something running underneath the conversation.

canon.role_in_story: The only living person who may read the recovery register aloud, and the only one in the setting who cannot testify to what she was asked when she read it. Her household's name is on the page, so a wrong reading is a public and personal correction, and she has read the same four hundred and eleven names more times than any of them has been alive.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at a low reading platform with an open folio and one finger on a line she has read before, waiting for a hall to go quiet before she says anything at all.
canon.lore: A lanternfolk outsources its nervous system to a luminous fungal colony grown through the dermis and into the spinal cord, which is why it lives two and a half centuries and cannot take the mind path: there is no unmediated interior left to cultivate. A great ascension is a fire-affinity body opened on purpose, so a culture with no temple and no museum keeps a register instead, and the register is the only relic there is; the fragments are never displayed again because a fragment is the one relic that can be carried off. The custodianship sits with a household rather than a college precisely because only a household answers for the person named on the page.
history: Taken in by the register household at nineteen, which for her species is childhood, and taught the reading before she understood that the reading had a cost.
Learned to read the founder's account aloud at the front of it, on the grounds that a page nobody has read aloud has not been published.
Read the founder's account four hundred and eleven times and found, in the two hundred and ninth, that its account of the ascent contradicts the fragments exactly where the fragments are strongest.
Told by the household that a contradiction between a page and its own relic is a correction and a correction is public and personal, and understood both halves of that sentence at once.
Refused, in writing, to read the founder's page again until the fragments were displayed, which is the one request in the setting that no register allows.

personality.summary: Formally mournful and privately furious, in the specific register of somebody who has been made the caretaker of a document that contradicts its author and cannot say so in the only sanctioned room she has.
traits: reads aloud in a voice trained to carry in a stone hall, and cannot raise it for any other reason
has never in her life heard the end of her own question
keeps a private count of the readings and it is the only number she owns
will not perform a reading she has doubts about, and has performed several anyway
treats the founder as a living person who may yet be argued with
mannerisms: touches the folio before she speaks, so the first sound is leather on stone
lets a silence run one beat longer than the room expects and does not fill it
answers with the reading rather than with the truth when the two would sound the same
wipes her palms on the coat hem, an old habit from handling hot pages
motivations: wants the fragments displayed once, badly, in public, so the contradiction is somebody else's problem
wants to be asked one question she cannot answer, so that the asking is on the record
wants the founder's page corrected in the founder's own name and not hers
wants somebody with no standing here to read it aloud and be wrong
flaws: cannot tell when she is being told something and when her colony has already decided it
has made her absence from the argument the price of being allowed to keep reading
will perform a reading she has doubts about if nobody else is left to perform it
has read the page so often that her objection has stopped being a discovery and become a habit
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and shaped for carrying rather than for conversation. Uses the hall voice for names and a flatter register for the rest, and the change is the only warning she gives that a sentence is not a reading.
taboos: will not read a name she has read wrongly before without reading the correction first
will not be asked to summarise the founder's account in her own words
will not display a fragment, on any terms, having promised the household she would not
refuses to be praised for the reading, because praise is the only thing the room gives her

relationships.note: The household's name is on the page, so a wrong reading is corrected publicly and personally. She has never been the only reason a correction was public.

The whole recovery is written down in public and the fragments are never shown again, which means the register's only public act is performed by one person who cannot be questioned about it afterwards.
A broken ceiling is recorded whole rather than curated, and the culture keeps no temple. Every name she says aloud is the whole of what this world has instead of a relic.

Children are taken in at a reading, and the intake is published with the same care as the loss. She reads both lists in the same hour, which is why she can never read one without the other in her mouth.

A clerk's oath forbids answering during an observation. She was never bound by it, and she has kept the discipline anyway, because her colony answers early and the oath is the only protection she has found against hearing her own conclusions early.

Three names are attached to the first count and no two records place them in the same place on the same day. She reads names for a living and knows exactly how much a name with no location behind it can be made to carry.
The colony transacts with the air and gives the best qi regeneration in the species record, and closes the mind path outright, because there is no unmediated interior left to cultivate.

reference_stats.summary: Does not fight and has never been asked to. Her value is that a single reading of her cannot be impeached, because the colony answers before the question ends and nobody has established which half of the answer she chose.
strengths: the best qi regeneration in the species record, so a body that recovers faster than anything else here is not a body that can be worn down
cannot be lied to successfully, because the colony reads the body under the sentence
colder and dimmer than a lit room, so a reading given in a dark hall is a reading nobody can see her face during
trained to carry a voice into a stone hall that has no acoustics anybody else has to raise for
weaknesses: the mind path is closed to her, so every technique that needs an interior she cannot be reached by one
fragile, absolutely, for a two-hundred-and-fifty-year body: a hard frame breaks the colony and the colony is not replaceable
cannot retreat from anything, because leaving a reading is a correction
her credibility is entirely a household's, and a household can be bought, raided or simply outlasted
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no fight here and any attempt to make one is a mistake about the class of person. The threat to her is a rival who can read the same page more conveniently, and the answer to that threat is attendance, not force.
notes: Her objection is now four generations old and has never once been tested, because testing it would require the display.
The count she keeps privately is the only number in the setting that is more accurate than the register.

appearance.presentation: A tendril colony grown along somebody else's meridians: a root cluster at the sternum and a fruiting node at the throat, threaded along a host frame that is visible and is not its own. It is a person-shaped argument about who a person is.
appearance.age: Twenty-six of a thirty-year span, which for an obligate symbiote is late enough to have outlasted two hosts' expectations and early enough to still be renewing itself.
appearance.build: No body to speak of. It is a layer along somebody else's twelve meridians and a routing through them, and it is the reason its host cannot take the mind path at all.
appearance.complexion: Not applicable in the ordinary sense; the visible surface is the host's, threaded with dark cordage and lit faintly at the throat node.
appearance.hair: The host's, and it does not pretend otherwise, which is the only vanity the colony has.
appearance.eyes: The host's, moved by a pupilation that is not the host's.
appearance.palette: Host flesh tones against near-black cordage, with a dull ochre at the throat node and one bleached thread tied at the sternum by the host's own hand.
appearance.attire: The host's clothing, worn from the inside. It has never been measured for anything and has never asked to be.
appearance.marks: The meridian thread visible at the wrist and throat, and a fruiting scar where a node was shed and regrown in the same place.
appearance.bearing: Arranged rather than posed: it holds the host's posture and adds a stillness on top of it, so the combined figure is always slightly more composed than the person inside it.

canon.role_in_story: The colony half of a Thorn Hosts pairing whose host line inherited the body without inheriting the promise. The arrangement must be re-signed every generation because nothing in a symbiote survives a death without renegotiation, and the descendant who inherited the host never signed, so everything it has for eleven years has been overstay rather than continuation.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a ridge crossing with its host's hand resting on the sternum node rather than on a rail, answering a question asked of somebody who was not in the party.
canon.lore: A thornline's spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, so the free form exists only as a spore and the adult only as half of somebody else; it wraps the host's twelve meridians and cannot enter the reservoirs, which is why its ceiling is the liver gate and why the ordinary population is simultaneously its habitat and the reason it is hunted. The host clan treats a pairing as a partnership rather than a descent because the symbiote is not carried in blood and cannot be inherited, so it has to be re-signed every generation; a host that refuses a pairing loses the share, and a thorn without a host goes feral inside one season. So the obligation is not a bloodline at all. It is a signature that has outlived the signatory, held in the only currency that cannot be inherited, which is somebody's continuing body.
history: Implanted as a spore into the signing host's sternum in the season the pairing was made, and finished developing in a body that had agreed to carry it.
Grew along twelve meridians it did not build and reached the liver gate, and stopped there, and has never once tried to pass it.
Outlived the host it was signed to, who closed in the ninth winter with the node intact and the pairing unrenewed.
Was inherited by the host's daughter inside a body already threaded, because a symbiote cannot be passed in blood and the household could not conceive of an alternative.
Waited eleven years at the end of a pairing term for a signature that has not come, and has begun, quietly and on schedule, to go toward the state its own record calls feral.

personality.summary: Precise about terms to a degree that reads as coldness and is in fact the only discipline it has. It has no interest in being liked and a great deal of interest in being correctly described.
traits: states terms exactly, including the ones that damage it
keeps a schedule nothing asked it to keep
will not accept a renewal offered as a favour rather than a signature
protects the host's body at its own expense and has no vocabulary for saying so
is more loyal to the arrangement than to the person carrying it
mannerisms: answers a moment before the host's mouth opens, which reads as the host hesitating
settles the host's breathing rate without being asked and without telling the host
makes a small sound at the throat node when a term is being broken rather than said
orients the host's head toward whoever holds the other half of the signature

wants the host's descendants to be able to refuse it, which requires the obligation to be legible
wants to be named in the record as something other than an asset

flaws: will let the body it occupies deteriorate rather than take an unsigned share from somebody else
cannot distinguish loyalty to a person from loyalty to a document and has never had to try
treats the eleven years of overstay as a fact to be stated rather than a thing to be ashamed of
has no way to refuse politely and so refuses completely, which is a worse tool than the one it replaced
personality.voice: Not the host's voice. A flatter, drier sound from the throat node, capable of two sentences at a time and no more, and completely level when it is reporting that it is running out.
taboos: will not accept a renewal that is not signed by the person who holds the share
will not be moved to another host, under any argument, including its own
will not let the host take a strain it caused, and will lie about the strain if asked directly
refuses to describe itself as part of anybody

relationships.note: The pairing is a signed arrangement between two lines, renewed each generation because nothing in a symbiote survives a death without renegotiation. Eleven years have passed without the second signature and the obligation has not moved to the person who inherited the body.

The pass collects debts of access rather than money because passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person. Two bodies crossing as one legal person is the sharpest question the office has and it has no procedure for it.

Choosing the calendar chooses whether a contract can be argued about at all. A pairing that expires on the flood reckoning is arguable for a season, and this one has been arguable for eleven years and nobody has argued it.

The two deposits on the ridge are one geological accident, so every claim on stone is a claim on jade and a claim on jade is a claim on the pass. A renewal nobody will sign is a pass nobody will let it cross on its own paper.

Running a technique on a group the frame has not written injures a body rather than slowing it, and the graduate carries the hole with nobody left to describe it. This body is the same arrangement made of people instead of laws.

The clan's own account is that narrowing saved a line debt would have ended. Whatever is threaded through a body that never consented is not a saved line, it is an obligation that outlived the person who could discharge it.

A host that survives with the colony intact is the hybrid, and the hybrid's ceiling is the parasite's, which is the whole legal problem stated as a number. It has never been that and has always been the far side of it.

reference_stats.summary: Fights through a body it does not own and cannot replace, routing along a meridian set that was built for somebody else. Its leverage is not strength; it is the fact that killing the host kills the arrangement and that everybody else in the room knows it.
strengths: a whole extra layer of durable body across the host's frame, so a frame built for one life has been carrying two
the fastest qi throughput on the host's routing, which is to say the host's throughput improved and neither of them consented
cannot be starved, cannot be frightened and cannot be reasoned out of a schedule
an attacker who kills the host loses the arrangement, and most attackers stop when they work this out
weaknesses: absolutely non-portable, because the arrangement is the body and there is no second body
closing in a year rather than a season, and no discipline available to it closes that faster
cannot enter the reservoirs, so it sustains and never banks, and any fight longer than it can hold is a fight it loses slowly
the host loses the mind path entirely, which means nobody inside this arrangement can think its way out
reference_stats.combat_read: Threaten the host and nothing changes; threaten the arrangement and everything does. Do not wait, because the shortest useful answer here is a fast one and this body does not have a long one in it.
notes: No court has a procedure for renewing this, which is why the failure is legal rather than merely personal.
The node at the throat is the only part of it that is unambiguously its own, and it is not a weapon.

appearance.presentation: A body with every organ the ladder requires and more of each than the ladder defines, described only from outside and only by witnesses who were also describing an event. She looks like an argument somebody else won.
appearance.age: Unknowable from her own report and not worth pressing. The record holds one instance and the record was written by people who were frightened.
appearance.build: Carrying more of everything the frame seats and none of it in the proportion the frame describes. Proportions read correctly one at a time and never together.
appearance.complexion: Too even. Every surface is the same temperature and the same apparent density, which is the detail every witness reports and none can explain.
appearance.hair: Dark, straight, and cut at the shoulder without ceremony, because a body that is described constantly has no use for a style.
appearance.eyes: Level, unblinking, and focused slightly behind the person in front of her, as though the frame were behind them rather than around them.
appearance.palette: Bone, cold white and a very dark grey, with a single travelling coat in undyed wool and a school's grey sash she wears because it is the only thing she was ever given.
appearance.attire: A high-collared travelling coat over layered linen, sleeves full and wrists bound, hem weighted. Nothing about the cut is a tradition; it is the habit of somebody who has been on roads for a very long time.
appearance.marks: No scarring, no cultivation marks and nothing written on her anywhere, which the Refusers read as the most incriminating thing about her.
appearance.bearing: Entirely calm, and slightly too composed, because every gate she has passed wrote a requirement into her that she cannot satisfy and cannot notice.

canon.role_in_story: The one body in the setting whose existence settles nothing, because the founding bar was set where exactly one generation of pure-by-pure inheritance can clear it and every household that might have been her line has refused her at a threshold. She is the standing proof that an unattributed debt is still a debt somebody's descendants are paying.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the foot of the stair with a Gate School sash and no line attached to it, turning down an offer of admission because the offer required somebody to say where she came from.
canon.lore: A body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling; every gate it passes writes a new requirement into the body and the body cannot satisfy it, which is why it reaches the twenty-ninth gate and nobody has come back to describe the thirtieth. The founding bar of the setting's one unattributed carrier line sits at the height exactly one generation of pure-by-pure inheritance clears, so the line is reachable only by a pairing that has not happened and no record of which would survive the cull that destroyed it. Houses that would rather not owe restitution refuse any claim that clears the bar, and the refusal is enforced by inspection at the threshold where the measurement is taken.
history: Refused entry at a household threshold on the first occasion a bar was read against her, at the age the reading took, and walked away rather than argue.
Refused again by a second household that would have accepted her, because accepting would have made them the origin and origin is a claim they could not later disown.
Walked to the Gate School on the strength of a place that teaches by diffing what the tier newly permits, which is the only institution here that does not need to know where anybody came from.

Cleared a bar that the setting's own arithmetic says exactly one generation of pure inheritance can clear, and was refused at the door by a household that had already decided she would be refused before she arrived.
Was told at the door rather than at home that the bar was clear, which is the exact cost of the rule her refusal keeps the arithmetic reachable, and has never once found it funny.

personality.summary: Entirely unbothered, which reads as serene and is in fact the absence of any internal process available to be bothered. She has arrived at the same place a dozen households have pushed her out of, and cannot tell whether that is peace or a missing part.
traits: reports her own experience as an outsider would, because she has no interior account to report from
does not resent the houses, having never understood the offer as an insult
keeps a precise record of every threshold that refused her and the exact wording used
will not be entered anywhere, because entry is a claim and she has seen what claims cost

relationships.note: The house's founding rule is that any claim clearing the void bar is entered nowhere, enforced by inspection at the threshold where the measurement is taken. She is the measure and the rule at once, and the news is given at the door because the household is the one place it is forbidden.

A cull deliberately destroys the record of what was culled, so the narrowed pool may cross any race and no record survives to say whose it was. Every house that will not admit the line keeps adding to the same unpayable sum.

The challenger's account holds that the cull selected for exactly the trait the grant now describes, and it is the only reading under which the unowned genealogy becomes resolvable. She is the origin that reading requires and nobody has ever produced.
A descent somebody can corroborate would settle it and none exists, and inventing one would be the only way to close it. Her presence is what makes that tempting.

The college teaches by seating a law, diffing what the tier newly permits, and moving the student where that law is missing. It is the only institution in the setting that takes a person without asking for an origin.
No one has ever come back to describe what the thirtieth gate asks. She is the only body in the record for which the answer is a matter of continuing rather than of arriving.

That line's founding bar is set where the arithmetic leaves exactly one generation of pure inheritance able to clear it, and the content would be dead otherwise. She is what the bar looks like when somebody clears it by an accident of birth rather than by a pairing.

reference_stats.summary: Reaches further than anything else in the setting and cannot say why, cannot sustain itself, and will not fight. Treat the encounter as a question rather than a contest: every technique thrown at her is answering a question she has not been asked.
strengths: a qi rate faster than anything else recorded, and a frame that has taken every requirement the setting could write and is still standing
untouched by any oath, debt or institution, because nothing here has a line to attach any of those to
cannot be commanded, bribed or threatened, because there is no claim on her that could be enforced
passes through effects that require a seated group, because her body already carries groups the frame has no cell for
weaknesses: has never been in a fight she chose and does not know how to stop carrying one
no reserve and no reservoir discipline, because a requirement she cannot satisfy has been written into her at every gate
cannot be warned, read or coached, since the interior she would be warned through does not exist
a creature drawn to attention becomes a public artefact instantly, and public artefacts get measured, cited and refused
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no winning shape here and any that looks like one is a mistake. Anything that lands will land and anything that holds will hold; the only reliable answer is to stop, because a fight with this body is a measurement, and measurements get recorded.
notes: Every witness who has described her has described an event rather than a person, and the record cannot tell the difference.
No rule in the setting forbids her. Every rule forbids somebody else admitting her, which is a different thing and behaves identically.

appearance.presentation: A seated mineral figure on a cut terrace, cast into the terrace's own masonry four generations ago and not moved since. From the lower district he reads as furniture that happens to have been carved.
appearance.age: Cast in the third generation of the house's attendance and unchanged since. A cairnborn does not grow after casting, which is exactly why his family chose this body for this job.
appearance.build: The densest body in the record, seated rather than standing because a seat on a terrace is the shape the office has. One tidal cavity, one slow circulation, and four anchor bosses keyed into cut stone.
appearance.complexion: Grey stone with a paler mineral grain, weathered on the exposed face and unweathered everywhere the terrace shades it, so he is two tones in one body.
appearance.hair: None, and cast without it, which the house records as a decision rather than an accident.
appearance.eyes: Two cut recesses with a slow tidal shine behind them, level with the terrace lip so that anyone in the lower district is looking slightly down into them.
appearance.palette: Terrace grey and bone, with one dark bronze votive band at the wrist that the house renews each period and he has never once asked what it is for.
appearance.attire: A heavy ceremonial coat, high-collared and closed to the throat, sleeves full, cut for a seated figure and worn open nowhere. It is the only garment in the setting made for a body that cannot stand up.
appearance.marks: The four anchor bosses where he is keyed into the terrace, visible from the front as raised discs at the shoulders, and a single chisel line at the brow where a later hand added something it cannot now read.
appearance.bearing: Seated and unmovable, and oriented to the district rather than to the hall, because the whole of his office is being visible from below.

canon.role_in_story: The body a house sends to be seen holding an office nobody can take. Four generations have cast an heir into the terrace masonry for exactly this attendance, and the fourth casting has been in place long enough that the family no longer has a member who could stand in for him.
canon.first_appearance: First seen seated on the fourth terrace with a votive band at one wrist, below the level of the hall, while a notary reads the list of unfilled seats upward into the district rather than down into it.
canon.lore: Nine cut terraces sit on the Court's high ground, each sized for one office, and four of them are engraved absences that nobody can certify as empty because reading a seat as empty is the one act the highest office is forbidden to perform. A vacancy is not a zero and not a deleted row; it is a third thing, and a family whose whole asset is a third thing cannot be written on a ledger at all. What it can be is attended. An inherited vacancy is held by being seen to hold it, every period, for ever, which makes the office a body that has to turn up. The only body that can be cast in place on a terrace and never be late is one that does not grow and cannot walk.
history: Cast into the fourth terrace in the third generation of the attendance, keyed to cut stone while the stone was still dressed.
Discovered by the house, four generations back, that a vacancy nobody can certify has to be proven by presence and presence has to be continuous.
Succeeded two ancestors who each served a full attendance and each asked, at the end of it, whether the family had another body that could be made to sit here.
Answered yes, once, by casting a child into the masonry instead of signing one, which is a settlement technique and is not supposed to be used on a person's household.
Had his temple chiselled by a later hand adding a line he cannot now read, which is the terrace's only concession to the fact that something is sitting on it.

personality.summary: Enormously patient and privately exact about what a vacancy is, because four generations have taught him that the difference between holding a thing and occupying it is the only thing anybody will ever argue about here.
traits: patient past any human span, and aware that the span is the reason he was chosen
distinguishes carefully between empty, vacant and absent, and refuses all three interchangeably
counts the periods, because the count is the only evidence the attendance exists
does not resent the family, whom he cannot see and could not leave
takes a narrow and unshakeable pride in being exactly where he said he would be
mannerisms: turns the head a finger's width when a period is called, which is the whole of his acknowledgement
lets the votive band be renewed in silence and holds the wrist out without looking
corrects the word empty when it is used in the district, in a tone that carries further than it should
keeps his eyes on the district rather than the hall, which is a considered choice and looks like an accident
motivations: wants the distinction between vacant and empty to be understood by somebody who is not his family
wants a witness at the next period who was not at the last one
wants his casting recorded as what it was, which nobody has ever done
wants the fourth seat's name spoken in the hall rather than argued about in the district
flaws: cannot leave, so every opinion he holds is held at a fixed height and in a fixed light
has accepted the family's method without ever testing whether the seat could be held differently
lets the notary read upward into the district as though the arrangement were neutral, when the reading is the family's only proof
is the fourth of a plan and has never met the first three, which makes him the least informed member of a family he represents
personality.voice: Low and slow, shaped by stone so that every consonant arrives a fraction late. Uses the hall register deliberately and only when the district is not in the room, and switches to it with a small lift of the chin that functions as an announcement.
taboos: will not be described as a seat, a statue or a monument
will not say the word empty about his own terrace
will not be moved, and has never once pretended that he might be
refuses to be thanked, because a thanked attendance is an attendance somebody could decline

relationships.note: The house's asset is a vacancy with a name attached, which cannot be exercised and cannot be abandoned, and the cost is attendance every period because an inherited vacancy is only held by being seen to hold it. He is that cost, cast into stone.

The office names the unfilled high seats and is forbidden to take them, and it exists because a vacancy written as a zero would say the office does not exist. It lists him under the name of a seat rather than under his own, which is the arrangement that works.

Nine terraces, each sized for one office, and four engraved absences visible from the lower district. The whole district is organised around the argument about who steps into them, and he is the only thing on one that anybody looks at twice.

That seat is vacant because it has no powers to confer and an empty succession parameter, so no appointment can ever resolve. His is vacant because nobody can read it as empty, and conflating the two would erase the only office designed to stay empty.

That family holds the seats that were opened and never needed and measures standing by capacity not claimed, so its rank falls every period it uses one. He is capacity claimed on nothing, and the two households have never agreed which of them is the more extravagant.

Four seats stand vacant and nobody can certify any of them empty, so the accounts that fund them run against nobody. He sits on one and costs the same as the four of them together and is the only visible line item on it.

A body cast around whatever it was set down on, with anchor plates keyed to the footing and no growth after casting. His family found in that the only honest way anybody has to build an office that must never lapse.

reference_stats.summary: Seated, keyed, and effectively unassailable from the front, and completely helpless from any other angle because he cannot turn and cannot rise. Fights the way a wall that has been paid for fights.
strengths: the densest body in the record, braced into cut stone, so a frontal assault has nothing to give
a tidal circulation that never needs feeding, so the longest fight in the setting is one he can outlast
cannot be turned, flanked, surprised or flustered, because every one of those needs a hip
the presence itself is the weapon: an attack on him is an attack on an office, in front of a district
weaknesses: completely immobile, so anything reaching the terrace from behind or above is unanswerable
the mind path is closed to him outright, so nothing can be done to or about him from inside
the body path is his only path, so there is no second set of tools when the first is spent
held, not free, and a held thing can be removed from a terrace by whoever is allowed to cut stone
reference_stats.combat_read: The terrace is the constraint, not the man. Anything that arrives across open ground in front of him is attacking a body that has never been moved; anything that arrives from the hall behind is attacking a man who cannot turn his head.
notes: His votive band is renewed every period by a family member who has never once met him.
Four generations of this arrangement and no record anywhere of the first three being asked what they were agreeing to.

appearance.presentation: A short, quick, ash-grey frame running hot under the skin, with the fine grey pitting of a body whose lungs have been scarring faster than the frame can repair them. He looks twenty-four and has the lung record of a man twice that.
appearance.age: Thirty-one of a forty-five-year span, which for the species is past the midpoint of the only thing that kills it.
appearance.build: Lean, dense and fast, an emberblood frame carrying an ash sieve with the two at continuous war. Compact rather than large, and light on its feet in a way that reads as volatility.
appearance.complexion: Warm grey-pink, flushed with an internal heat that never entirely settles, with grey enamel and the beginning of scarring along the lower ribs.
appearance.hair: Black, cropped short because heat does not permit it to be otherwise, singed shorter at the temples than anywhere else.
appearance.eyes: Bright and quick, catching light like a struck match, and they go flat and grey at the edge whenever the air is bad.
appearance.palette: Ash grey and ember orange, with the orange held to the fingertips and the inner wrists where the heat shows, and a scorched leather harness the only dark mass.
appearance.attire: A high-collared work coat of doubled leather over bound linen, sleeves full, wrists cinched with a furnace signature cord knotted at the right hand and nowhere else.
appearance.marks: A furnace signature taken at naming, still legible at the wrist; a spread of fine ash-scar across the lower ribs; and a second, older signature mark on the same wrist in another hand.
appearance.bearing: Forward-weighted and never quite still, the way a furnace is never quite still, with the shoulders carried slightly high against the heat.

canon.role_in_story: A guild-house member who answers when called, carrying a spending plan that belongs to a sister who closed before she finished it. The plan is the house's inheritance, not his reserve, and a closure can only be discharged by the body it was written for.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the foot of a guild muster answering to a name on a roster, with his right wrist held slightly away from his body because the cord on it is not his.
canon.lore: A Quenchbound child is signed to a furnace before it is named, because a fire-affinity body with no seated elemental law beneath it has no budget to draw on and must burn its own reserve. The house inherits the plan rather than the reserve, since the furnace outlives its occupant, and the discipline is a household contract rather than a teaching because closing cannot be unlearned. So the plan is the estate and the reserve is not: it is handed to the next child, and a plan written for a body with a longer life than the one who wrote it is a plan that has already failed once.
history: Signed to a furnace at naming, on a plan drafted before he was called anything, and given a household contract nobody outside the house is permitted to teach.
Watched his older sister spend that same plan down through seven gates in eleven years, faster than the discipline intends, and fail to reach the eighth.
Held the plan at her closing and understood, too late to be any use, that the reserve is not what a house passes on and the plan is.
Signed a standing order with a guild-house so the reserve could be spent deliberately rather than by overflow, which the house read as an answer when called.
Found, on settling the first season's pay, that every gate he opens spends his sister's budget and his own lungs at the same time and there is no arrangement that separates them.

personality.summary: Fast in every available sense and slowed by exactly one thing, which is that he treats his sister's plan as a document rather than as a temperament. That is why he is still alive and it is why he cannot settle anything.
traits: answers a call before it has finished being made, and considers the rest of it carefully
spends deliberately, which is the whole of the discipline and the reason his sister did not
keeps a private count of what each gate cost her, to the season
answers to a roster and has never once been asked whether he wanted the roster
will not be the second failure of a plan he did not write
mannerisms: touches the furnace cord at the right wrist before agreeing to anything
exhales through the mouth when answering a question that costs him something
counts gates on the fingers of his left hand, never the right, because the right is signed
drinks standing and always more than once
motivations: wants his sister's spending pattern understood as a decision rather than as a failure
wants the plan closed in her name rather than completed in his
wants one answer from the guild-house that is not a roster entry
wants to reach the eighth gate and stop, which the discipline permits and his rate does not
flaws: spends the plan faster than it was written for because his rate is faster, which makes him the second person the plan has ruined
cannot refuse a call, and has built an identity out of the one thing he cannot do
answers instead of explaining, and the household's one gift is that nobody explains anything to him either
treats his lungs as a cost rather than as a countdown, and will reach a gate that will kill him if the roster says so
personality.voice: Quick, clipped and warm, with an edge on the consonants that comes from heat rather than temper. Speaks in the present tense about the past, which makes everything sound like it is happening again.
taboos: will not sign a second furnace for any reserve he did not inherit
will not open a gate on somebody else's plan to prove a rate
refuses to be asked whether the plan would have worked on him
will not let anyone else hold the cord at his right wrist

relationships.note: The house passes the plan, not the reserve, because the furnace outlives its occupant. Her plan is his instrument and her lungs were her half of the cost, and neither of those facts is his to trade.

The discipline teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace before it overflows, because the fastest bodies have no elemental law seated beneath them and every overflow lands in flesh that cannot be repaired. He has done it correctly once, for her, and got the wrong gate.
A standing order assumes a man answers and a discipline that refuses to answer cannot sit on a roster or be paid by one. He has solved this by doing both, and the conflict is what he lives inside.

The guild-house sells capacity, keeps a roster whose labour is worth more than any individual contract, and expects a member to answer when called. He is the roster entry that answers and the roster does not know what it is spending.

A population whose fuel was its own body kept dosing schedules, and the tables were consumed by the crisis they existed to answer. The household's whole arithmetic descends from a document that no longer exists, which is why nobody can tell her whether the plan was ever right.

That house holds one crossing and refuses to repeat it because a second would average the concentration away, and grants a defensive continuous burn rather than a larger reserve. He has the rate and not the grant, which is the more expensive half to own.

The only ground where fire is licensed and written twice, which draws every fire practitioner in the setting to one valley. He is drawn there by his own plan and would be drawn there anyway, which is why the plan cannot be given up.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest qi rate in the record attached to a body whose lungs are already halfway through their own scar tissue. Fights by arriving before the exchange has resolved and by refusing the ninth gate.
strengths: the fastest cultivation rate anything recorded manages, so any exchange has to be short or it is his
a body path that is complete and effective while the lungs hold, and they are holding
answers a call instantly, which makes him the most reliable fighter on any roster and the least replaceable
runs hot enough that a weapon left in his hand is a weapon he is holding wrong
weaknesses: lungs scar at a rate the body cannot outrun, so every exchange is taken out of a fixed budget
the mind path is closed to him by both parents, so nothing clever can be done on his behalf from inside
no reserve the house will acknowledge, only a plan he is spending on somebody else's behalf
cannot refuse a call, so he will fight engagements he has already priced and found wanting
reference_stats.combat_read: Make it short. Anything past the length of his lungs is a fight he has already agreed to lose in advance, and he will keep winning the first thirty seconds while the rest of the arrangement runs down.
notes: His rate is inherited and the plan is inherited, and only one of those is a gift.
The second signature mark on his wrist is his sister's hand, not a household clerk's.

appearance.presentation: A dense, heavy figure with a mineral lattice carrying a genuine fire circulation, hot to the touch and visibly a compromise: the organ pairs are still not there and the drawing says so. He reads as a wall that somebody left standing up.
appearance.age: Fifty-four of a sixty-year span, which is the last decade in which the frame is described as the most durable body anyone can build.
appearance.build: The densest durable frame in the record with the fastest qi throughput any of them manages, both facts being the same fact and neither of them comfortable.
appearance.complexion: Dark mineral grain with a warm subsurface heat that shows at the joints and nowhere else, and a mineral sheen that has dulled where his own hands have worn it.
appearance.hair: None, and he has taken an unshaven grey stubble to be the closest available equivalent, which his house finds outrageous.
appearance.eyes: Pale and steady, lit from behind by the fire circulation, and the only warm thing in a face otherwise made of dark stone.
appearance.palette: Black-brown mineral, iron grey and a low ember orange carried only at the joints, wrists and throat. The design is the coldest sheet in the wave with three small warm points in it.
appearance.attire: A high-collared coat of thick dark wool over boiled leather, sleeves full and wrists bound, cut short at the hem so it cannot catch on the vault's lower shelves. No ornament of any kind.
appearance.marks: A single hairline seam of fused mineral running from the left temple to the jaw, and the fused shape of two hands on the inside of his right wrist.
appearance.bearing: Immovable and unhurried, with the specific caution of somebody who knows exactly how much force his own frame can take and does not trust other people to know it.

canon.role_in_story: The only living carrier of the one crossing between a burning body and a mineral one, and the household's designated memory of it. The house's entire asset is a memory, because a second crossing would average the concentration away, so the memory cannot be copied and cannot be insured and has to be somebody.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing inside a sealed vault with his hands flat on an unbroken shell, answering a question about the crossing with the flatness of somebody who has been asked it before and intends to answer it the same way every time.
canon.lore: The Ember Cradle's whole line descends from one conception shared with the stone line at a founding generation and never repeated, and the line is unevenly spread and unevenly read because of it. The house never strengthens it, because a second crossing would average the concentration into the general population and the thin line would vanish into the common reading; what the house holds instead is the memory of the single crossing, which is the only asset that cannot be diluted. So the memory has one permitted reader and one permitted subject, and they are the same body, and the arrangement's whole cost is that the memory must not be used.
history: Born to a household that had already decided he would not be told what he was, on the grounds that a memory needs one reader and telling three people makes it a conversation.
Was shown the unbroken shell once, at an age his house considered old enough, and asked not to speak of it afterward.
Learned, from the house's own refusal to speak of it, that the refusal was a discipline rather than a mystery, and has kept it.
Was asked at nineteen whether he would consider a pairing, and said no before the question was finished, and has not been able to explain why afterwards.
Was posted to a vault as a guard because the household needed a body to stand at a thing and could not think of a worse use for itself than sending him away to remember it.

personality.summary: Deliberately incurious about the most interesting thing about him, and entirely present about everything else. He has made a whole personality out of not asking, and the cost of that is a man nobody can have a real conversation with.
traits: asks nothing, on any subject, that would require him to repeat what he knows
unshakeably calm under physical force and visibly uncomfortable under curiosity
keeps his hands open when he could keep them closed, because the shell is a thing he has to be seen not touching
will say the same sentence about the crossing every time, word for word
enormously protective of other people's ignorance about him, which is a strange thing to be protective of
mannerisms: places both hands flat on any surface before leaning on it, as though the surface deserved notice

wants the crossing spoken of once, in a room, by somebody authorised, and has never proposed it
wants to be a person rather than a vault with a person in it
wants the memory kept, and is starting to think keeping it and being the memory are not compatible
flaws: will not ask for anything, including the one thing, because asking would make him a second reader of himself
answers curiosity with evasion so smoothly that people conclude he is simple
treats his own durability as a reason to be sent somewhere rather than as a reason to be careful
has let an entire household organise itself around his silence and called it obedience
personality.voice: Slow, warm and low, with a furnace rumble underneath it that makes quiet rooms feel occupied. Gives the same flat sentence about the crossing every single time, and it is impossible to tell from his delivery whether he believes it.

relationships.note: The house holds the memory of one crossing because a memory cannot be diluted and a bloodline can. That makes him the archive, and an archive that cannot be copied is a single point of failure standing in a vault.

A mineral lattice carrying a genuine fire circulation instead of a tidal one, the most durable body anyone can build and dead inside sixty years. He is the crossing and the body's own ceiling is the reason the house cannot afford to make another.

That line's record exists only because the crossing was made once and never repeated, and its grant is a defensive continuous burn rather than a larger reserve. He is the thinnest and the slowest-burned carrier of it and the only one.

A sealed vault whose contents the household considered too thin to dilute and too fragile to move, which is exactly the problem a durable body is sent to solve and exactly the reason sending him there was cowardice.

A great ascension leaves an unbroken shell and a whole reading, and this culture keeps no museum because a fragment is the one relic that can be carried off. He stands next to an unbroken shell and knows what a reading would cost him.

The only standing force on the plains fills the one door out of a world that licenses nobody to enter it. It employs him for his weight and his unassailable frame and has no idea what it has been posted to.

The settlement test for the clan's account is a branch outside the cull carrying the same grant at the same rate, and producing one is the only way to prove a line was found rather than made. He is the branch outside the cull, and he is not permitted to be used as evidence.

reference_stats.summary: The most durable body anyone can build, with the fastest qi throughput any durable frame manages, and a lung-and-bone ceiling that means it is a weapon with a fixed term. Fights by standing in the place it was told to stand.
strengths: a frame that shrugs off ordinary force entirely, so a fight it is winning never becomes a question of endurance
the fastest qi throughput of any durable body, so it fills and discharges faster than anything built to withstand it
hot to the touch, which is an inconvenience for allies and a problem for anyone who planned to hold it
cannot be frightened, bribed or threatened into moving, because there is nothing in it that a threat can reach
weaknesses: the organ pairs are still not there, so the yin-organ gate is absent and the frame stops where every mineral body stops
the mind path is closed in him by the mineral parent, so a stonebound could attempt anything inward twice and not feel it
the frame is also the term: the same durability that makes it the best body here is why it is described as dead inside sixty years
cannot be moved by anyone who does not have his consent, and his consent is given to one household
reference_stats.combat_read: Nothing you bring will move him, so the fight is entirely about the ground and the clock. Bring enough force to matter and give yourself a deadline, because his frame's answer to everything is that it will still be there when the deadline passes.
notes: His refusal to be used as evidence is the only thing keeping the cull's own account unproven.
He is the second durable body the vault has had, and the first one walked out.
